en.Подробные решения на русском по файлу «L: Detailed solutions in English based on the file "Lista zadań nr 2.pdf" from the Drive folder. The figures from the statements are taken into account (positions of bodies, directions of forces, the v(t) graph in 2.9). Calculations use g = 9.81 m/s².
en.К задачам ↓Конспект лекций 1–4Список № 1: To the problems ↓Lecture notes 1–4List no. 1
en.В каждой задаче: условие, идея, основная: Every problem has: the statement, the idea, the main formula and a step-by-step solution with the answer. Solve it yourself first, then check against the answers. Dynamics formulas are in the notes for lecture 3.
en.Отмечено допущение: в 2.4 система в поко: Assumptions made: in 2.4 the system is at rest (sum of external forces = 0), in 2.6 and 2.8 the directions of forces and positions of bodies are as in the figures of the statement; in 2.9 the graph values were read from the picture (6→9→9→3 m/s, at times 0, 3, 5, 7 s).
en.Бросок вверх с высоты 50 м: Throw upward from a height of 50 m
en.Условие. Тело на высоте H = 50 м брошено: Statement. A body at height H = 50 m is thrown vertically upward at 20 m/s (A — launch point, B — top point, C — level A again on the way down, D — the moment t = 5 s, E — ground). g = 9.81 m/s². Find: a) the time to B; b) the distance AB; c) the time to C and the velocity vC; d) the velocity and position after 5 s; e) the total flight time; f) the velocity before hitting the ground.
en.Идея. Движение с постоянным ускорением g: Idea. Motion with constant acceleration g directed downward. The y axis points up, the origin is the ground: y(t) = H + v₀t − gt²/2, v(t) = v₀ − gt.
en.В верхней точке v = 0: tB = v₀/g = 20/9,: At the top v = 0: t<sub>B</sub> = v₀/g = 20/9.81.
en.Подъём и спуск до уровня A симметричны:: The rise and the descent to level A are symmetric: t<sub>C</sub> = 2t<sub>B</sub>. The speed there equals v₀ in magnitude but is directed downward.
en.v = 20 − 9,81·5 = −29,05 м/с. Смещение о: v = 20 − 9.81·5 = −29.05 m/s. Displacement from A: Δy = 20·5 − 4.905·25 = −22.6 m, i.e. the body is 22.6 m below A.
en.v ≈ −29,1 м/с (вниз); высота над землёй: v ≈ −29.1 m/s (downward); height above the ground ≈ 27.4 m
en.Условие. Радиус-вектор мяча: r = (18t, 4: Statement. The position vector of the ball: r = (18t, 4t − 4.9t²) (m, s). Find the initial velocity and angle, the velocity at the top point and at t = 2 s.
en.Идея. Скорость — производная радиус-вект: Idea. Velocity is the time derivative of the position vector: vx = dx/dt, vy = dy/dt. The coefficient 4.9 = g/2, i.e. g ≈ 9.8 m/s².
en.Там vy = 0 (при t = 4/9,8 ≈ 0,41 с), ост: There v<sub>y</sub> = 0 (at t = 4/9.8 ≈ 0.41 s); the horizontal component remains.
en.Горизонтальный бросок: нормальное и танг: Horizontal throw: normal and tangential acceleration
en.Условие. Шарик брошен горизонтально с v₀: Statement. A ball is thrown horizontally with v₀ = 7.55 m/s. After t = 0.5 s find the velocity, the normal acceleration an and the tangential acceleration as (g = 9.81 m/s²).
en.Идея. Полное ускорение равно g и направл: Idea. The total acceleration equals g and points downward. The tangential component is the projection of g onto the direction of the velocity, the normal one onto the perpendicular to it.
en.Три тела на пружинах — сила F₃: Three bodies on springs — force F₃
en.Условие. Тела A, B, C соединены пружинам: Statement. Bodies A, B, C are connected by springs. Force F₁ = 6 N acts on A (according to the figure — horizontally toward B), and a resultant F₂ = 8 N acts on B (upward, perpendicular to F₁). Find the force F₃ on C.
en.Идея. Система находится в покое, поэтому: Idea. The system is at rest, so the sum of external forces is zero (the internal spring forces sum to zero by Newton's third law): F₁ + F₂ + F₃ = 0.
The x axis is along F₁ (to the left), the y axis along F₂. F₁ = (−6; 0) N, F₂ = (0; 8) N ⇒ F₃ = (6; −8) N.
en.Противоположно сумме F₁ + F₂: вниз и от: Opposite to the sum F₁ + F₂: downward and from B toward A. Angle with the horizontal tan β = 8/6 → β ≈ 53.1° below the horizontal.
en.Условие. F₁ = −7ĵ, F₂ = 5ĵ, F₃ = −8î + 2: Statement. F₁ = −7ĵ, F₂ = 5ĵ, F₃ = −8î + 2ĵ, F₄ = 4î (N), m = 4 kg. Find: a) the resultant; b) the acceleration; c) the angles of the acceleration vector with the axes; d) the balancing force.
en.Идея. Складываем силы покомпонентно, зат: Idea. Add the forces component by component, then Newton's second law: a = F/m.
en.Вектор направлен против оси x: cos α = −: The vector points against the x axis: cos α = −1, cos β = 0.
en.α = 180° с осью x, β = 90° с осью y: α = 180° with the x axis, β = 90° with the y axis
en.Fур = −F — та же величина, противоположн: F<sub>b</sub> = −F — the same magnitude, opposite direction.
en.Три бруска на гладкой поверхности: Three blocks on a smooth surface
en.Условие. Бруски m₁ = 1 кг, m₂ = 2 кг, m₃: Statement. Blocks m₁ = 1 kg, m₂ = 2 kg, m₃ = 3 kg stand in a row; F₁ = 12 N acts on the left one to the right, F₂ = 6 N on the right one to the left (according to the figure). Find the acceleration of the system and the interaction forces between adjacent blocks.
en.Идея. Вся система движется с общим ускор: Idea. The whole system moves with a common acceleration (an inextensible chain). First a for the whole system, then the second law for individual blocks.
en.Для бруска 1: m₁a = F₁ − N₁₂ ⇒ N₁₂ = 12: For block 1: m₁a = F₁ − N₁₂ ⇒ N₁₂ = 12 − 1.
en.Для бруска 3: m₃a = N₂₃ − F₂ ⇒ N₂₃ = 3 +: For block 3: m₃a = N₂₃ − F₂ ⇒ N₂₃ = 3 + 6. Check for block 2: N₁₂ − N₂₃ = 2 = m₂a ✓.
en.Машина Атвуда, груз застревает: Atwood machine, the weight gets stuck
en.Условие. Через блок перекинута нить; m₁: Statement. A string is passed over a pulley; m₁ = 1 kg (on the floor), m₂ = 2 kg (at height H = 3 m). After release m₂ reaches the floor and gets stuck. Find the maximum height reached by m₁ and the time, g = 9.81 m/s².
en.Идея. Два этапа: 1) совместное движение,: Idea. Two stages: 1) joint motion while m₂ descends by H; 2) the string goes slack, and m₁ flies upward like a thrown body with the speed reached at the end of stage 1.
en.a = (2 − 1)·9,81/3 = 3,27 м/с². Скорость: a = (2 − 1)·9.81/3 = 3.27 m/s². Speed at the end: v = √(2aH) = √19.62 = 4.43 m/s. Time t₁ = v/a = 1.35 s. The mass m₁ has risen by 3 m.
en.После удара m₂ нить провисает, m₁ движет: After the impact of m₂ the string goes slack and m₁ moves freely: h = v²/(2g) = 19.62/19.62 = 1.0 m; t₂ = v/g = 0.45 s.
en.Высота над полом: 3 + 1 = 4 м; время: 1,: Height above the floor: 3 + 1 = 4 m; time: 1.35 + 0.45 = 1.81 s.
en.Три массы: два груза и тело на столе: Three masses: two weights and a body on a table
en.Условие. m₁ = 3 кг и m₃ = 1 кг висят по: Statement. m₁ = 3 kg and m₃ = 1 kg hang at the edges of a table on a string over pulleys, m₂ = 6 kg lies on the table (frictionless). Find the acceleration and the string tensions.
en.Идея. Нить нерастяжима, поэтому все три: Idea. The string is inextensible, so all three bodies have a common acceleration. m₁ is heavier, so the system moves toward it. The tensions on the left and right differ — write the second law separately for each body.
en.m₁g − T₁ = m₁a ⇒ T₁ = m₁(g − a) = 3·7,84: m₁g − T₁ = m₁a ⇒ T₁ = m₁(g − a) = 3·7.848.
T₂ − m₃g = m₃a ⇒ T₂ = m₃(g + a) = 11.77. Check for body 2: T₁ − T₂ = 11.77 = m₂a ✓.
en.Условие. Тело массой m = 6 кг движется п: Statement. A body of mass m = 6 kg moves along a straight line, v(t) graph: from 6 m/s at t = 0 it grows linearly to 9 m/s at t = 3 s, the speed is constant until t = 5 s, then it falls linearly to 3 m/s at t = 7 s. Find the force during the 2nd, 4th and 6th second.
en.Идея. Сила по второму закону F = ma, а у: Idea. By the second law F = ma, and the acceleration is the slope of the v(t) graph: a = Δv/Δt. The graph points were read from the picture in the PDF.
en.Условие. Пуля m = 10 г со скоростью v =: Statement. A bullet m = 10 g with speed v = 200 m/s penetrated a board to a depth of l = 4 cm. The motion is uniformly decelerated. Find the force and the stopping time.
en.Идея. Равнозамедленное движение до остан: Idea. Uniformly decelerated motion until stopping: v² = 2al, t = v/a, then F = ma.
en.Контейнер на палубе наклонённого судна: A container on the deck of a tilted ship
en.Условие. Контейнер m = 1 т на палубе. a): Statement. A container of m = 1 t on the deck. a) Draw the forces. b) The maximum tilt angle without sliding for fs = 0.35. c) The angle at which the container slides uniformly for fk = 0.3. d) The acceleration at a tilt of 20°.
en.Идея. На наклонной плоскости: N = mg cos: Idea. On an inclined plane: N = mg cos α, the force along the slope is mg sin α, friction ≤ f·N.
en.На контейнер: тяжесть mg (вниз), нормаль: On the container: weight mg (downward), normal reaction N (perpendicular to the deck), friction T (along the deck, up the slope). On the deck the reaction forces act: pressure N and friction T, equal in magnitude and opposite (third law).
en.Контейнер не скользит, пока mg sin α ≤ f: The container does not slide as long as mg sin α ≤ f<sub>s</sub>mg cos α ⇒ tan α ≤ f<sub>s</sub>.
en.Равномерно: a = 0 ⇒ mg sin α = fkmg cos: Uniformly: a = 0 ⇒ mg sin α = f<sub>k</sub>mg cos α ⇒ tan α = f<sub>k</sub>.
en.20° > 19,3°, контейнер скользит: a = g(s: 20° > 19.3°, the container slides: a = g(sin α − f<sub>k</sub> cos α) = 9.81·(0.342 − 0.3·0.940).
en.Турист на обледенелом склоне: A hiker on an icy slope
en.Условие. Склон α = 15°, масса туриста с: Statement. Slope α = 15°, mass of the hiker with a backpack m = 80 kg. a) Will they climb for fs = 0.25? b) What friction coefficient is needed? c) What is the maximum upward acceleration for fs = 0.3?
en.Идея. Чтобы идти вверх, трение покоя под: Idea. To walk uphill, the static friction of the soles must balance the component of gravity along the slope mg sin α (and provide acceleration). The maximum friction is fsmg cos α.
en.tg 15° = 0,268 > 0,25, т.е. максимальное: tan 15° = 0.268 > 0.25, i.e. the maximum friction is smaller than the sliding force: f<sub>s</sub>mg cos α = 189.7 N < mg sin α = 203.1 N.
en.Не взойдёт — будет скользить вниз: They will not climb — they will slide down
en.Брусок под углом: когда он оторвётся: A block pulled at an angle: when it lifts off
en.Условие. Брусок m = 5,1 кг на гладкой по: Statement. A block m = 5.1 kg on a smooth surface is pulled with force F = 12 N at an angle α = 25° to the horizontal. Find the acceleration and the force at which the block lifts off the surface.
en.Идея. Горизонтально работает F cos α, ве: Idea. Horizontally F cos α acts; vertically F sin α relieves the support: N = mg − F sin α. Lift-off happens when N = 0.
en.Два груза: наклонная плоскость и блок: Two weights: an inclined plane and a pulley
en.Условие. Груз m₁ = 9,5 кг на склоне α =: Statement. A weight m₁ = 9.5 kg on a slope α = 34° is connected by a string over a pulley to a hanging weight m₂ = 2.6 kg. Find the acceleration and the string tension: 1) without friction; 2) with f = 0.15.
en.Идея. Груз m₁ тянет вниз по склону m₁g s: Idea. The weight m₁ pulls down the slope with m₁g sin α = 52.1 N, which exceeds m₂g = 25.5 N, so m₁ slides down while m₂ rises. For the system: a = (m₁g sin α − m₂g − Ffr)/(m₁ + m₂); the tension from the equation for m₂.
en.Условие. Лыжник спускается по склону α =: Statement. A skier descends a slope α = 5° with initial speed v₀ = 20 m/s, f = 0.18. What distance until stopping?
en.Идея. Так как f = 0,18 > tg 5° = 0,087,: Idea. Since f = 0.18 > tan 5° = 0.087, friction exceeds the sliding force — the skier slows down. Deceleration a = g(f cos α − sin α), distance s = v₀²/(2a).
en.Брусок у вертикальной стены: A block against a vertical wall
en.Условие. Брусок m = 3 кг прижимают к вер: Statement. A block m = 3 kg is pressed against a vertical wall with force F at an angle of 50° to the horizontal (upward and toward the wall), f = 0.25. For which F does the block stay at rest?
en.Идея. Горизонтально: N = F cos 50°. Верт: Idea. Horizontally: N = F cos 50°. Vertically: F sin 50° pulls upward, friction is directed against possible sliding. Two limiting cases: the block is about to slide down (friction up) and about to slide up (friction down).
en.Чтобы не сползал: F(sin 50° + f cos 50°): To avoid sliding down: F(sin 50° + f cos 50°) ≥ mg ⇒ F ≥ 29.43/(0.766 + 0.161).
en.Чтобы не ехал вверх: F(sin 50° − f cos 5: To avoid moving up: F(sin 50° − f cos 50°) ≤ mg ⇒ F ≤ 29.43/(0.766 − 0.161).

en.Условие. Контейнер m = 50 кг, fk = 0,2,: Statement. A container m = 50 kg, fk = 0.2, uniform motion. Fig. a — force F₁ is directed downward at α = 30° (pushing), fig. b — F₂ upward at α = 30° (pulling). a) Why is F₁ > F₂ without calculations? b) Find F₁ and F₂.
en.Идея. Равномерное движение: a = 0. Гориз: Idea. Uniform motion: a = 0. Horizontally, the component of the force balances friction; vertically, gravity together with the vertical component of the force.
en.При толчке вертикальная составляющая F₁: When pushing, the vertical component of F₁ presses the container to the floor, the normal force grows, and friction with it. When pulling, F₂ lifts the container, so N and friction decrease. Hence pushing is harder.
